name: CCA 3101 起落架问题 刹车问题 积冰/防冰

cards.audioText: Your call sign is CCA 3101, a flight from Beijing to Guangzhou, you are parking at Gate 215, you are ready for pushback and startup, contact Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是 CCA 3101，这是一趟从北京飞往广州的航班，停在 215 登机口，已准备好推出和开车，联系北京地面。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 3101, Gate 215, request pushback and startup.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 3101，215 登机口，申请推出和开车。

cards.audioText: CCA 3101, Beijing Ground, pushback and startup approved, facing west.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 3101，北京地面，推出和开车批准，机头朝西。
cards.referenceText: pushback and startup approved, facing west, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 推出和开车批准，机头朝西，CCA 3101。

cards.audioText: Now you have completed pushback and startup, you are ready for taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已完成推出和开车，准备滑行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 3101, pushback and startup completed, request taxi.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 3101，推出和开车已完成，申请滑行。

cards.audioText: CCA 3101, Beijing Ground, taxi via taxiway Y4 and G2, hold short of H.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 3101，北京地面，经 Y4 和 G2 滑行道滑行，在 H 前等待。
cards.referenceText: taxi via taxiway Y four and G two, hold short of H, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 Y4 和 G2 滑行道滑行，在 H 前等待，CCA 3101。

cards.audioText: During taxiing, you notice the Airbus 330 in front of you is leaking fluid from the right engine, report it to Beijing Ground.
cards.audioTextZh: 滑行期间，你注意到前方 Airbus 330 的右发正在漏液，向北京地面报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Ground, CCA 3101, the Airbus 330 ahead is leaking fluid from the right engine.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京地面，CCA 3101，前方 Airbus 330 的右发正在漏液。

cards.audioText:
C: roger, thank you. CCA 3101, continue taxi.
B: tell the controller that you are unable to taxi because you find the taxiway surface is contaminated with leaking fluid.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： 收到，谢谢。CCA 3101，继续滑行。
B： 告诉管制员你无法滑行，因为发现滑行道道面被泄漏液体污染。
cards.referenceText: we are unable to taxi, the taxiway surface is contaminated with leaking fluid, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们无法滑行，滑行道道面被泄漏液体污染，CCA 3101。

cards.audioText: CCA 3101, roger, turn left, taxi via Y1, then turn left, taxi via Y2.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 3101，收到，左转，经 Y1 滑行，然后左转，经 Y2 滑行。
cards.referenceText: turn left, taxi via Y one, then turn left, taxi via Y two, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转，经 Y1 滑行，然后左转，经 Y2 滑行，CCA 3101。

cards.audioText: Now you are at holding point Runway 36R, you are ready for departure, contact Beijing Tower.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你位于 Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场，联系北京塔台。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 3101, holding point Runway 36R, ready for departure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 3101，Runway 36R 等待点，已准备好离场。

cards.audioText: CCA 3101, line up and be ready for immediate departure.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 3101，进入跑道，并准备立即离场。
cards.referenceText: line up and be ready for immediate departure, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进入跑道，并准备立即离场，CCA 3101。

cards.audioText: CCA 3101, Runway 36R, cleared for immediate takeoff, surface wind 340 degrees, 2 meters per second.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 3101，Runway 36R，许可立即起飞，地面风向 340 度，风速 2 米/秒。
cards.referenceText: Runway 36R, cleared for immediate takeoff, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: Runway 36R，许可立即起飞，CCA 3101。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 3101, stop immediately, I say again, stop immediately.
B: tell the controller you used the maximum brakes and you are stopping on the runway.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CCA 3101，立即停止，我再说一遍，立即停止。
B： 告诉管制员你使用了最大刹车，正在跑道上停下。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 3101, we used the maximum brakes, we are stopping on the runway.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 3101，我们使用了最大刹车，正在跑道上停下。

cards.audioText: CCA 3101, vacate runway via E2.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 3101，经 E2 脱离跑道。
cards.referenceText: vacate runway via E two, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 经 E2 脱离跑道，CCA 3101。

cards.audioText: Now you have vacated Runway 36R via E2 and ask Beijing Tower the reasons for rejected takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你已从 E2 脱离 Runway 36R，询问北京塔台中断起飞的原因。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 3101, Runway 36R vacated via E two, confirm the reasons for rejected takeoff.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 3101，已从 E2 脱离 Runway 36R，请确认中断起飞的原因。

cards.audioText: CCA 3101, the landing aircraft on the short final just made the go around.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 3101，刚才位于短五边的落地航空器复飞了。
cards.referenceText: roger, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，CCA 3101。

cards.audioText: now you find your brakes are overheating, tell the controller you need two minutes to cool the brakes.
cards.audioTextZh: 现在你发现刹车过热，告诉管制员你需要两分钟为刹车降温。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 3101, our brakes are overheating, we need two minutes to cool the brakes.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 3101，我们的刹车过热，需要两分钟为刹车降温。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 3101, what assistance do you need?
B: Tell the controller you need ground services to cool the wheels.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CCA 3101，你需要什么协助？
B： 告诉管制员你需要地面服务为机轮降温。
cards.referenceText: request ground services to cool the wheels, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求地面服务为机轮降温，CCA 3101。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 3101, what else do you need?
B: tell the controller one of your nose wheel tyres was deflated, you have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CCA 3101，你还需要什么？
B： 告诉管制员你的一个前轮轮胎瘪了，必须在当前位置等待维修检查。
cards.referenceText: one of our nose wheel tyres was deflated, we have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们的一个前轮轮胎瘪了，必须在当前位置等待维修检查，CCA 3101。

cards.audioText: after the check, the maintenance staff told you that your parking brakes have seized, report it to the controller.
cards.audioTextZh: 检查后，维修人员告诉你停留刹车已卡死，向管制员报告。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Tower, CCA 3101, our parking brakes have seized.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京塔台，CCA 3101，我们的停留刹车已卡死。

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 3101, what assistance do you require?
B: tell the controller you need a tug to tow you back to the maintenance apron.
cards.audioTextZh:
C： CCA 3101，你需要什么协助？
B： 告诉管制员你需要一辆牵引车将你拖回维修机坪。
cards.referenceText: request a tug to tow us back to the maintenance apron, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 请求一辆牵引车将我们拖回维修机坪，CCA 3101。

cards.audioText: CCA 3101, hold position, the tug will come soon.
cards.audioTextZh: CCA 3101，保持位置，牵引车很快会来。
cards.referenceText: holding, roger, thanks, CCA 3101.
cards.referenceTextZh: 保持位置，收到，谢谢，CCA 3101。
